author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Anbernic has released one of their most confusing devices to date: it is called the RG Vita but doesn't play much PS Vita.  Let's take a look.

This device goes up for pre-order in mid-March, I'll add links then.

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
